definitions.explanation: Describes the amount of time required to do something. Used with time expressions.
Describes the amount of money required for something. Used with money/cost expressions.

examples.japanese: {駅|えき}まで{十|じゅっ}{分|ぷん}かかります。
examples.english: It takes ten minutes to the station.

examples.japanese: この{仕事|しごと}は{時間|じかん}がかかります。

notes: A very common verb with many meanings. In the sense of 'take time/cost,' the pattern is usually: [time/money]がかかる. Other meanings include: {電話|でんわ}がかかる (to receive a call), {橋|はし}がかかる (a bridge spans/is built), {鍵|かぎ}がかかる (to be locked).
